policies.recall: designer's policy — buy every affordable recall
policies.recallOne: frugal — at most ONE recall per expedition, so the price is always the cheapest rung k=0
policies.recallRich: buy recalls but keep a 5,000 gold cushion

offersIsTheInterruptionCount: offers = number of times the 3-card choice opened = modal decision events in the window

staleRecallReplay.repro: expedition N: buy recall with payload {restRecalls:0} (k 0->1). Duplicate of the SAME payload is correctly rejected. Let the rest expire, heroChoose starts expedition N+1 (restRecalls reset to 0). Re-send the SAME payload {restRecalls:0}.
staleRecallReplay.conclusion: restRecalls is NOT an offerSerial-equivalent: it resets every heroChoose, so a queued/duplicated IPC from the previous expedition spends gold in the next one.
